title: Harnessing Frémy's salt for tyrosine-directed bioconjugations
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4299-4304
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06489A, Paper
Open Access

Zachary V. Samuels, Ava Stoddard, Wei-Siang Mark Kao, Mike A. Cornejo, Emilia Strugala, Shane A. McGlone, Lauren Furer, Cindy Rodriguez, Brian M. Zeglis
A tyrosine-directed bioconjugation strategy was developed in which Frémy's salt facilitates SPOCQ cycloaddition-mediated ligations with TCO-bearing cargoes. The tyrosine-linked probes have similar in vitro and in vivo performance compared to lysine-linked analogues.
